title: Ensuring Mental Well-being of National Servicemen
what_it_is: Ensuring Mental Well-being of National Servicemen

sections.label: Rising pre-enlistee mental health issues
sections.summary: Pre-enlistee mental health detection rose from 6% in 2019 to 11% in 2023, prompting MINDEF and SAF measures and doubling full-time mental health professionals to 80.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Over the past five years, the proportion of pre-enlistees detected to have mental health issues jumped from 6% in 2019 to 11% in 2023, although the majority have mild to moderate conditions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: To deal with this rising trend, the Ministry of Defence (MINDEF) and the Singapore Armed Forces (SAF) reviewed our overall system and instituted a slew of measures to better support psychological and psychiatric conditions of our Full-Time National Servicemen (NSFs) and Regulars.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: We have doubled the number of full-time mental health professionals in MINDEF and SAF to 80 today, up from about 40 a decade ago.

sections.label: Deferment of severe cases
sections.summary: Severe cases posing harm to themselves or others are deferred from National Service until professionals assess their conditions have improved and no longer pose those risks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Severe cases that pose harm to themselves and/or to others are deferred from National Service (NS) until the professionals assess that their conditions have improved and no longer pose those risks.

sections.label: Care Hubs and psychological first aid
sections.summary: Care Hubs were set up in Pulau Tekong in 2022 and Kranji Camp in 2020, and all BMT recruits undergo psychological first aid training to support their paired buddies.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: New Care Hubs have been set up in Pulau Tekong in 2022 and Kranji Camp in 2020, where BMT is conducted.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: But all of us are also aware that signs of mental distress can be subtle and often it is those who we spend most time around who can pick it up.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Therefore, for BMT, all recruits also undergo psychological first aid training to help them to recognise distress signs, cope with challenges, exercise self-care and provide support for their buddies whom they are paired with.

sections.label: Suspension of NS duties
sections.summary: If conditions worsen during NS to the extent of posing danger to themselves or others, NS duties may be suspended until they become better or indefinitely for some.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: Should their conditions worsen during NS to the extent that they pose a danger to themselves or others, their NS duties may be suspended till they become better or for some, indefinitely.

sections.label: MINDEF/SAF Mental Health Office
sections.summary: A MINDEF/SAF Mental Health Office was set up in December 2022 to coordinate all these efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: To coordinate all these efforts, a MINDEF/SAF Mental Health Office was set up in December 2022.

sections.label: Working with other agencies
sections.summary: MINDEF and the SAF will work with other agencies to improve mental health and well-being for NSFs and Regulars.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Mr Heng Chee How) (for the Minister for Defence)
sentences.text: To this end, MINDEF and the SAF will work with other agencies to improve mental health and well-being for our NSFs and Regulars.
